description: This file contains utility functions for persisting and retrieving user profile data to/from a Supabase database. It includes functions to get the current user ID, load a user profile with skills, and save/update the profile data, emphasizing a secure and safe data handling pattern.

methods.name: getCurrentUserId()
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's ID from Supabase. Returns an object indicating success and the user ID or an error reason.

methods.name: loadProfileAndSkillsFromSupabase()
methods.description: Fetches the profile and skills of the current user from the 'user_profiles' table in Supabase. Returns structured result based on existence and errors.

methods.name: saveProfileAndSkillsToSupabase(payload)
methods.description: Upserts (inserts or updates) the profile and skills data for the current user into the database, handling safety checks and error reporting.
